description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing channels, memberships, and messages, as well as methods for managing channel flow and messaging configurations.

classes.name: ChimeSDKMessagingClient
classes.description: Client class to facilitate interaction with Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: associateChannelFlow
methods.description: Associates a channel flow with a channel.

methods.name: batchCreateChannelMembership
methods.description: Adds multiple members to a channel in a batch.

methods.name: channelFlowCallback
methods.description: Handles callback for channel flow operations.

methods.name: channelFlowCallbackAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous callback handler for channel flow.

methods.name: createChannelBan
methods.description: Bans a user from a channel.

methods.name: createChannelMembership
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel.

methods.name: createChannelModerator
methods.description: Assigns a moderator to a channel.

methods.name: deleteChannelBan
methods.description: Removes a ban from a user in a channel.

methods.name: deleteChannelMembership
methods.description: Removes a member from a channel.

methods.name: deleteChannelMessage
methods.description: Deletes a message from a channel.

methods.name: deleteChannelModerator
methods.description: Removes a moderator from a channel.

methods.name: describeChannel
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific channel.

methods.name: describeChannelBan
methods.description: Describes details of a channel ban.

methods.name: describeChannelFlow
methods.description: Gets details about a channel flow.

methods.name: describeChannelMembership
methods.description: Provides information about a channel membership.

methods.name: describeChannelMembershipForAppInstanceUser
methods.description: Describes channel membership for an app instance user.

methods.name: describeChannelModeratedByAppInstanceUser
methods.description: Describes channels moderated by a specific user.

methods.name: getChannelMessageStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a message.

methods.name: listChannelBans
methods.description: Lists banned users in a channel.

methods.name: listChannelMembershipsForAppInstanceUser
methods.description: Lists channel memberships for a specific app instance user.

methods.name: listChannelsAssociatedWithChannelFlow
methods.description: Lists channels associated with a specified channel flow.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags attached to a resource.

methods.name: putChannelExpirationSettings
methods.description: Sets expiration settings for a channel.

methods.name: putChannelMembershipPreferences
methods.description: Sets preferences for a channel membership.

methods.name: redactChannelMessage
methods.description: Redacts a message in a channel.

methods.name: sendChannelMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a channel.

methods.name: updateChannelMessage
methods.description: Updates a message in a channel.

methods.name: updateChannelReadMarker
methods.description: Updates the read marker for a channel.
